model: In-process reducer, persistent synthetic workspace per scenario
limitations: No database, API authorization, continuation transaction, capacity, network, real staff or AI model exercised.
UUIDs are random; counts and scenario schedule are deterministic.
Tier labels are scenario labels only, not empirical geographic assumptions.

results.assumptions: One eight-hour scope and one draft per day; identical workload, no demographic inference.

errors.soft: This workspace has reached its soft acknowledgement limit. Start a new simulation to continue.
errors.monitorDuplicateApprove: Only a prepared or paused shift monitor can be approved.
errors.handoverCreate: This workspace has reached its handover draft limit. Start a new simulation to continue.
errors.monitorCreate: This workspace has reached its shift monitor limit. Start a new simulation to continue.
